recipe.visualDefinition: A centered vintage van in a desert landscape at sunset, featuring a silhouetted figure standing on the roof with arms outstretched, framed by large-scale expressive brush lettering in the sky and wide-spaced sans-serif text at the base.
coreVisualRelationships: The figure's silhouette acts as a vertical bridge between the heavy van and the airy sky lettering.
The warm orange desert ground contrasts with the cool blue upper sky gradient.
The van's custom side-panel mural mirrors the natural landscape themes.
The wide horizontal spacing of the bottom text anchors the verticality of the central subject.
coreInvariants: Van must be a 1970s-style boxy utility model.
The figure must have arms extended horizontally.
The color palette must transition from deep orange to pale yellow to sky blue.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis; van occupies the lower middle third, figure stands at the center point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the van against the bright horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bottom wide-spaced text, moves up through the van to the figure, and finishes at the large script in the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky area provides breathing room for the large expressive title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden-yellow and orange (sunset atmosphere and ground).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the horizon line; low value (dark) for the van and figure silhouette.
paletteRestrictions: No harsh blacks; use deep browns or navy for shadows

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Thick brush strokes with visible bristle textures and dry-brush edges.
Bottom text: Monolinear, geometric, wide-set characters with high tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the script has an elongated tail that underlines the preceding word.
The 'T' has a long, sweeping crossbar that extends over the 'I' and 'R'.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, textured script paired with rigid, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif for stability.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, textured energy of the sky title.
Provides the necessary geometric weight for the bottom anchor.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle shot of a 1970s tan van parked on a desert road at sunset. A man stands on the roof with arms wide. The sky is a gradient of orange to blue with a hazy sun. The ground is red-orange dirt. Ensure the van has a custom mural on the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, cream-colored brush-script title in the upper sky area with a slight upward tilt. Place a bold, white geometric sans-serif name at the very bottom, spaced out to span the entire width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the figure's silhouette clearly defined against the sky?
Does the brush script have visible bristle textures?
Is the bottom text tracking wide enough to touch both margins?
Is the horizon line perfectly horizontal?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the van
Exact facial features of the figure
Specific artist name or album title
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic lighting on the van's surfaces.
Ensure the figure's scale is proportional to the van.
Verify the brush script doesn't obscure the figure's head.
Confirm the bottom text is legible against the ground texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject silhouette + horizon-split color palette + textured script header + wide-tracked sans-serif footer.
